items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Well, Russell Bennett was conducting the pit orchestra.

ctx.x: Well with John Hammond, he asked me would I like to join Raymond Scott up at CBS? He approached me when I was with Cab, and the money was good, you know, and I said yes, and there was a variety of arrangements and I just wanted to change, and I wanted to be in New York too, and I took the gig. And then John Hammond was also the instigator of me leaving CBS to join Carmen Jones. Because Oscar Hammerstein and John were very dear friends, and Billy Rose. So John Hammond says, 'well Cozy, it's a job, it's a show…

Carmen with a whole colored cast and it's going to be a hit, Cozy, believe me, I wouldn't tell you to leave CBS here to go over here with this show if I didn't think it was going to be a hit." Well, Russell Bennett was conducting the pit orchestra.
